title: A Unified Framework for Microscopy Defocus Deblur with Multi-Pyramid Transformer and Contrastive Learning
caption: Figure 2. Overview of MPT. MPT constructs an explicit pyramid block at each stage. Inside the pyramid block, CSWAs constitute a coarse-to-fine pyramid, exploring cross-scale spatial interaction for each scale. The ISCA is built beside each CSWA to provide global channel context. Information from CSWA and ISCA is aggregated by FEFN using the asymmetric activation mechanism.
